data.one_liner: A Flutter widget that lets users pick a location using Google Maps.
data.what_it_does: It displays a Google Map, shows the user's current location, and returns the selected place details. It also supports restricting selection to a circular area and custom zoom controls.
use_when: You need an interactive map for users to select a place
You want built‑in handling of location permissions and place details
You prefer a ready‑made UI over building it from google_maps_flutter yourself
avoid_when: You only need a static map or simple marker placement
You require a fully custom UI without the provided picker overlay
strengths: Integrates Google Maps, Geolocator and Places APIs in one widget
Provides extra features like circular restriction and custom zoom controls
Handles permission requests and location fetching out of the box
weaknesses: Relies on multiple native APIs, increasing setup complexity
Limited customization compared to building your own picker
Package maintenance may lag behind upstream dependencies
data.setup_notes: Add Google Maps API keys for Android (AndroidManifest) and iOS (AppDelegate/Info.plist). Enable location permissions in Info.plist and Android manifest. Enable AndroidX and set compileSdkVersion >=28. Optionally enable embedded views preview on iOS.

alternatives.name: google_maps_flutter
alternatives.why_pick_it: Provides the raw map widget; you can build a custom picker with full control

alternatives.name: flutter_map
alternatives.why_pick_it: Open‑source map solution without Google API keys, useful for offline or non‑Google maps

alternatives.name: geolocator
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you only need location fetching without the map UI
